steps.title: Cabernet Sauvignon
steps.body: Margaret River Cabernet Sauvignon, often blended with Merlot, is elegant and structured, with blackcurrant, cedar, herbs and fine tannins. It's frequently compared with Bordeaux. Producers like Cullen, Moss Wood, Vasse Felix and Cape Mentelle are famous. Cabernet is the region's most important red.

steps.title: Chardonnay and SBS
steps.body: Margaret River Chardonnay is among Australia's best: rich yet fresh, with stone fruit, citrus, nuts and oak. Leeuwin Estate's Art Series Chardonnay is iconic. Sémillon and Sauvignon Blanc blends, called SBS or SSB, are a local speciality: crisp, herbal, citrus and fresh, inspired by Bordeaux whites.

steps.prompt: Match each wine to its style.
steps.explanation: Margaret River's wines draw on Bordeaux and Burgundy.

steps.body: Margaret River Sémillon Sauvignon Blanc is a refreshing, affordable everyday white, great with seafood.

steps.prompt: Which white blend is a Margaret River speciality?

steps.title: What you learned
points: Margaret River Cabernet is elegant and Bordeaux-like
Its Chardonnay is among Australia's best
Sémillon Sauvignon Blanc blends are a speciality
